0022600024.text: The Suns (1-2, 11th in the West) are at home against the Denver Nuggets (2-2, 9th in the West) in Emirates NBA Cup West Group A play, with Phoenix on a one-game losing streak and Denver on a one-game winning streak. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with a shoulder injury following surgery, while Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (personal reasons), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Suns lost all three games to Denver, most recently 125-123 in Phoenix on March 24, 2026.
